images.title: A net of an octahedron
images.purpose: Show one net of an octahedron: two fans of 4 equilateral triangles joined along one edge.
images.composition: One net centred on white, the two fans in two colours, the shared edge highlighted.
images.exact_structure: Exactly 8 equal equilateral triangles with thin dark outlines, centred and large. Fan one: 4 triangles all sharing one lower point, side by side, covering two thirds of a full turn, filled teal #0072B2. Fan two: 4 triangles all sharing one upper point, side by side, covering two thirds of a full turn, filled amber #E69F00. The two fans share exactly one edge, which is one of the 4 outer edges of each fan (an edge that does not pass through either shared point), drawn thick in reddish purple #CC79A7, with one fan on each side of it and no triangles overlapping. Label 'top half' beside the amber fan, 'bottom half' beside the teal fan, 'joined here' with a thin pointer to the shared edge, and under the net '8 faces'.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Two fans of 4 triangles joined along one edge fold into an octahedron with 8 faces.
